  Why the 401 was a red herring

  The curl I ran first returned 401 against the gateway, and that's exactly what tripped me up earlier in this session when auth genuinely had lapsed. But a bare curl
  sends no OAuth header, so 401 is the correct answer to an unauthenticated request — it says nothing about whether my session is valid. The only real test is a live tool
  call, and that succeeded.

  Worth remembering: last time the tell wasn't the 401, it was that the sync tools had vanished from my toolset entirely. They're all still here.

  Nothing to resume — THING-704 is closed and the work is safely on the remote. The two open items are unchanged and still need your call: the locus fix 4575e651f is
  still unpushed, and /learn is still owed for this unit.
